about: Olectra Greentech Limited manufactures and sells electric buses and trucks in India. It operates in two segments, Composite Polymer Insulators and E-Vehicle. The company offers electric tippers. It also provides 1200KV, 330-420KV, 220-245KV, 110-132KV, 52-77KV, 33-36KV, 22-28KV, and 10-15KV composite polymer insulators for transmission and distribution; and tonne, bracket tube, and stay arm insulators for railways.
